jobs.title: Contaminated Land and Water Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real\-world impact.


“For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive.


When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact.


Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way.


**A Day in the Life**
---------------------

Formerly known as Epic Environmental, the Australian arm of Onterris has kept the strong culture we are well known for. The team continues to work closely with clients, building trusted relationships and delivering high\-quality outcomes without an overemphasis on KPIs .


Our teams have the opportunity to work alongside industry leaders, auditors, and professionals with vast experience within our industry, while enjoying regular social events and collaborative work that bring the team together. Onterris also supports career development through relevant internal opportunities and individual one\-on\-one career conversations focused on growth and progression.  



We are seeking a n experienced Environmental Scientist to join our growing Contaminated Land and Water team out of our Brisbane office. Have the opportunity t o work alongside more than 45 land and water professionals across Australia who are actively invested in mentoring, collaboration and your long\-term career development.


This role will be responsible for a full range of activities including:


* Planning and delivering field investigations across a variety of sites – including soil, groundwater, and surface water assessments
* Preparing clear and high\-quality reports
* Acting as the representative/client contact on site for Onterris
* Attending business development meetings
* Supporting project managers and ensuring open and clear communications when in the field
* Project managing minor projects
**Your Expertise and Skills**
-----------------------------

These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here.


* 3\-5 years consulting experience in contaminated land
* Tertiary qualifications in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Management or related disciplines
* Solid understanding of QLD and national environmental frameworks
* Confidence in the field and an eye for detail and technical excellence
Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. For more information, visit www.onterris.com .


We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We acknowledge that these experiences and perspectives help to enrich our teams and contribute to our ongoing success. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our employment for all applicants. For US residents, click here to learn more.

jobs.description:
reqId: 168635
Category: Professional Services
Location: North Sydney, New South Wales, 2060
Casual
  
**What’s on Offer**

* On\-going, full\-time casual opportunity (40 hours/week) on environmental monitoring projects running from September
* Comprehensive training provided and will work autonomously once established
* Company vehicle supplied for project work
* Work across Sydney and surrounding regions, with future project expansion opportunities

 **About the Role**


Reporting to the Project Manager the Environmental Scientist will collect and report data on petroleum fuel sites across Sydney.

**Key responsibilities will include, but are not limited:**

* Coordinate schedule, as well as weekly project mobilisations
* Gauge and sample groundwater wells, detecting any fuel contamination
* Annotate site maps and conduct site inspection
* Instrument operation and maintenance
* Conduct well maintenance and repairs
* Occasional travel and remote work
* Completion of chain of custody paperwork

 **About you:**


You will demonstrate a strong ability to work autonomously, alongside the following:

* Full Drivers License
* 1\+ years’ experience in groundwater monitoring, environmental sampling, and equipment calibration and maintenance
* Hands\-on experience using hand tools and environmental monitoring equipment
* Proven ability to work independently in the field while meeting targets and deadlines
* Strong organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail

 **About the Team**


Ventia’s Environmental Services team has been transforming some of the country’s most contaminated land and waterways, monitoring and analysing environmental factors and threats, and developing innovative, technology\-driven solutions for more than 35 years.


We have a strong understanding of contaminants, including PCBs, dioxins and per\- and poly\-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).


Our clients include state and federal governments, the Australian Department of Defence, ASX 200 companies, developers, air services including airports, and fire authorities.

 **About Ventia**  

As a leading services provider, we maintain, operate, and manage the essential infrastructure that makes modern life possible across Australia and New Zealand. With more than 35,000 employees and subcontractors across 400 sites, joining Ventia means becoming part of a team that values its people, supports career growth, and helps everyone go further towards their full potential.  

  

Our commitment to Fairness, Inclusion and Respect shapes how we lead, collaborate, hire and support one another. We welcome applications from people of all ages, abilities and backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all genders, identities, sexual orientations, beliefs and caring responsibilities. We are dedicated to providing an accessible recruitment process and encourage you to request adjustments at any stage.


**How to apply**  

Click the Apply Now button to start the journey to find your further with Ventia.
